messages.subject: Edwards (2011) Formative Measurement Model
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to run a model using Edwards (2011) alternative model for formative measurement (attached). It's mentioned that when single indicators are used for the reflective measures that certain parameters need to be fixed. However, I am using multiple indicators for the reflective constructs and I am still having identification issues. Does anyone have any guidance on which parameters need to be fixed? Here is my model: 

FormativeMeasure<-' #Measurement Model 

                                     Reflective1=~X1+X2+X3+X4+X5+X6+X7+X8 
   
                                      Reflective2=~X9+X10+X11+X12+X13+X14+X15 + X16 
         
                                       Reflective3=~X17+X18+X19+X20  
   
                                       Formative<~Reflective1+Reflective2+Reflective3' 

Any help would be appreciated, and please let me know if I should direct this question somewhere else.

messages.author: 0678d266a1c8817c
messages.subject: Re: Edwards (2011) Formative Measurement Model
parts:
I think Lavaan is a package for covariance-based structural equation modelling. So the model you said is not be supported. 

Two ways to handle this: 
1. all the regression coefficients from the 3 factors to the Result_factor are fixed to a constant (typically 1). Then you will be able to 'estimate' the variance of the 'Result_factor',
2. Change the package you used to a PlS-SEM package.

Best
TUO

Hi,

 

You need to fix the error variance to zero and all weights to 1.

 

For an explanation of the identification problem that you have, see:

 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MiMNeZajEW8&list=PL6tc6IBlZmOXRZoKVFh6GA0OrMtpIqLdz&index=3

 

Mikko
